findings.evidenceJa: サクっと死んだ貴方を一から鍛え直す
findings.governingReading: The rescue corner retrains from scratch the player who has just died abruptly.
findings.explanation: The English changes a specific post-death retraining address into a general service for people prone to dying.

findings.highlight: Senior student! Your name in this dojo is senior student!
findings.evidenceJa: 弟子一号！　この道場では貴様の名称は弟子一号！
findings.governingReading: Taiga forcibly assigns Illya the title “Disciple Number One.”
findings.explanation: Senior student again deletes both numbered identity and disciple hierarchy, damaging a recurring dojo formula.

findings.highlight: the demonic sword, Tora-shinai, is fearsome indeed
findings.governingReading: Illya calls the Tiger Bamboo Sword a fearsome demonic blade.
findings.explanation: Leaving 虎竹刀 as an unexplained romanized compound hides the tiger/bamboo-sword construction needed for the mock item notification and later Tiger joke.

findings.governingReading: Taiga utters “Chesuto” as a stylized striking cry.
findings.explanation: The English mistakes the kiai for the anatomical noun “chest,” breaking the blow-and-pain sequence.

findings.highlight: A girl like you who kills out of love
findings.evidenceJa: 愛情転じて殺人にいたるようなちびっ子
findings.governingReading: A little girl whose affection transforms and ends in murder is ordered to run laps.
findings.explanation: Kills out of love removes the transformation mechanism and makes murder a direct expression of affection.

findings.evidenceJa: ヘンな猫を追い返しましたー。
findings.governingReading: Illya reports that she drove the strange cat away.
findings.explanation: “Go somewhere” removes both expulsion from the dojo and the playful repetition of “strange cat.”
